summary: The PR-172 claim contract is admissible only as an internal roadmap_rescue_v1:C1 metamorphic software/model self-consistency battery. COMMON owns the harness, result pack, mutation report, manifest, and status; OBSSTAT contributes observable-transform and estimator-convention semantics. A pass cannot be described as physical validation, matched-data/null/covariance validation, observational support, transfer validation, parity of the sky, morphology compatibility, geometry evidence, family identification, or an independent oracle. The scientific status remains OPEN and public_use remains false.

findings.summary: Cap the result at internal roadmap_rescue_v1:C1 metamorphic self-consistency; scientific status remains OPEN and public_use remains false.
COMMON owns the battery and evidence artifacts; OBSSTAT contributes observable-transform and convention semantics.
The CO-04 delta must identify anisotropy-specific additions without counting same-estimator transformed runs as a second independent oracle.
Freeze the exact B-parity action and call the result convention-consistency, distinguishing invariance, equivariance, and anti-equivariance.
Any surviving, missing, substituted, or unexecuted preregistered mutant blocks the affected estimator and aggregate success.
Keep process, estimator, and science axes separate; only a complete clean-and-mutation pass may satisfy PR-180's requires_success edge.

verdict.assignment_disposition: The claim review is complete; this is not a PR-172 execution result.

claim_audit.risk: A software mechanics pass could be promoted to validation of the estimator, data, physical model, or sky.
claim_audit.required_fix: Freeze the C1 ceiling in the spec, result card, manifest, PR delta, status projection, and claim-language mutation tests. Preserve scientific_status=OPEN and public_use=false after a mechanics pass.

claim_audit.risk: Observable convention expertise could be confused with ownership of model-dependent inference or diagnostic certificates.
claim_audit.required_fix: Record COMMON as owner of the battery, harness, manifest, mutation report, and status. Record OBSSTAT as contributor and owner only of observable-feature/convention semantics where separately typed. Do not assign HTT inference, MIO certificate, BASS transfer, or TSC legacy ownership to this result.

claim_audit.risk: Running the same estimator on transformed inputs could be counted as a second independent oracle or as duplicate closure of PR-123/CO-04.
claim_audit.required_fix: The CO-04 delta note must state that PR-172 adds anisotropy-specific metamorphic relations for frame/convention and monopole-projection defects on the same estimator lineage. It must include an overlap table keyed by PR-123 mutation/relation ID with reused, extended, and new rows; it must not double-count a reused mutation kill or claim independent implementation, external replication, or a second oracle.

claim_audit.risk: The title's physics-invariant wording and the B-parity label can collapse invariance, equivariance, or anti-equivariance and can be misread as a statement about physical parity or the observed sky.
claim_audit.required_fix: Preregister the exact B-parity input action, expected output action, relation class, parity sign/exponent, coordinate orientation, handedness, spin/basis and complex-conjugation conventions, mask/support action, domain, and frozen tolerance. Use invariant only for an unchanged output; use equivariant or anti-equivariant when an output transform or sign is expected. Result prose must say registered B-parity convention-consistency MR, not physical parity validation.

claim_audit.risk: An empty, unexecuted, no-op, substituted, or partially killed mutation battery could become false green.
claim_audit.required_fix: Require a nonempty frozen relation and mutation registry; exact source/fixture/config hashes; proof that each mutant was activated and differs on the intended surface; a clean-baseline pass; expected mutant failure; exact execution counts; and a zero-survivor report. Any surviving or unexecuted preregistered violation blocks the affected estimator and prevents an aggregate success disposition. Threshold or relation changes after viewing results require a new contract version and full rerun.

claim_audit.risk: A completed evidence package could be conflated with a successful estimator disposition or scientific closure.
claim_audit.required_fix: Keep separate process, estimator, and science axes. Emit PASS_METAMORPHIC_SELF_CONSISTENCY_C1 only if every frozen relation passes, every required mutant is killed, the CO-04 delta is explicit, and provenance/manifest gates pass. Emit BLOCKED_METAMORPHIC_RELATION_VIOLATION for any clean failure or surviving registered violation; emit INCONCLUSIVE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE for missing execution/provenance; emit BLOCKED_CONTRACT_INVALID for an ambiguous or physically unsupported relation. The PR may archive a terminal failure artifact, but it must not satisfy the requires_success edge to PR-180. Scientific status remains OPEN in every route.

allowed_uses: Internal regression testing of the exact registered estimator surfaces.
C1 evidence that outputs obey the frozen metamorphic relations on the declared fixtures and transform domain.
Fail-closed gating of an affected estimator and downstream cards that explicitly require successful PR-172 mechanics.
A non-duplicative CO-04 delta showing the anisotropy-specific relations added beyond PR-123.
forbidden_uses: Matched-data, matched-null, covariance, calibration, coverage, significance, or observed-inference validation.
Evidence that the physical sky obeys parity, that B-like structure is detected, or that a physical model is correct.
Transfer validation, native BASS validation, native-solver readiness promotion, morphology compatibility, geometry evidence, or Bianchi-family identification.
An independent implementation, independent oracle, external replication, or two independent votes obtained by evaluating one estimator twice.
HTT posterior/evidence, MIO certificate, truth certificate, release claim, or closure of any OPEN scientific remediation finding.

fail_closed_result_language.success: On the preregistered fixtures and transform domain, the tested estimator outputs satisfied every registered symmetry-transform metamorphic relation, including the frozen B-parity response, and every registered violation mutant was killed. This is an internal roadmap_rescue_v1:C1 software/model self-consistency result. It is not matched-data, null, covariance, transfer, observational, physical-parity, morphology, geometry, or Bianchi-family validation, and it is not an independent oracle.
fail_closed_result_language.b_parity: Under the frozen B-parity transform and the stated basis, handedness, orientation, mask/support, domain, and tolerance conventions, estimator <ESTIMATOR_ID> was <INVARIANT|EQUIVARIANT|ANTI_EQUIVARIANT> according to relation <RELATION_ID>. This is convention-consistency on the registered fixtures, not a physical-parity or observed-sky claim.
fail_closed_result_language.blocked: At least one preregistered metamorphic relation failed on the clean estimator or one registered symmetry-violation mutant survived for estimator <ESTIMATOR_ID>. The estimator disposition is BLOCKED_METAMORPHIC_RELATION_VIOLATION; PR-172 has no success disposition, and downstream consumers requiring PR-172 success remain blocked.
fail_closed_result_language.incomplete: Required transform, fixture, mutation-activation, execution, provenance, or manifest evidence is missing or invalid. PR-172 is INCONCLUSIVE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE; absence of a detected violation is not a pass.
fail_closed_result_language.invalid_contract: The registered relation is ambiguous, internally inconsistent, or incompatible with its declared support/conventions. PR-172 is BLOCKED_CONTRACT_INVALID. Any repaired contract requires a new version and a full fresh replay.

risks_and_kill_switches: A transformation that is not a true relation on the declared mask/support or convention domain invalidates the contract; it is not evidence against the estimator until the relation is repaired and rerun.
A data-dependent or post-result tolerance invalidates the result.
A survivor, missing mutant execution, or missing activation proof blocks the affected estimator and aggregate success.
A clean-estimator relation failure blocks the estimator even if all mutants are killed.
Same-estimator transformed runs are correlated self-checks and cannot be counted as independent evidence.
An aggregate that hides a per-estimator failure is invalid.
The PR-151 read-only fast probe is required at PR-172 start and end; no partial PR-151 mock may enter PR-172.
artifacts_and_status_updates_needed: A frozen PR-172 spec defining transform domain, exact relations, B-parity conventions, mutation registry, tolerances, terminal routing, and claim ceiling before outputs are viewed.
A content-addressed metamorphic relation report with clean and mutant primitive records.
A mutation kill matrix and zero-survivor or explicit survivor report.
A CO-04 delta note with PR-123 overlap classification and correlation/non-independence disclosure.
A claim-tiered result card and complete artifact manifest.
A claim-language mutation report and independent non-author review envelope.
PR delta and status update that separate process completion, per-estimator outcome, and unchanged OPEN scientific status.

proposed_changes: Replace unqualified result uses of physics-invariant with registered symmetry-transform self-consistency unless the frozen relation truly leaves the output invariant.
Use the exact success/block/incomplete/invalid language in this envelope or stricter language.

downgraded_claims: Any proposed estimator validation claim is downgraded to registered C1 metamorphic self-consistency.
Any proposed B-parity physics or observed-sky claim is downgraded to a convention-scoped metamorphic relation result.
Any proposed second-oracle or independent-replication claim is downgraded to a correlated same-estimator self-check.
